description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Signal Enrichment Cache in the Eclipse Ditto framework, including methods to obtain cache timeout duration, cache configuration, and default configuration values.

classes.name: CachingSignalEnrichmentFacadeConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration access methods for signal enrichment cache, including timeout and cache config retrieval, and default config values enumeration.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for cache retrievals.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration to apply for each connection scoped signal enrichment cache.
